title: http-message-signatures and its XEdDSA answer say the age recipient is the verification key only when XEdDSA's scalar is the clamped identity
goal: kb/public/auth/http-message-signatures.md's DER line on signing with XEdDSA (the line naming xeddsa_verify) and the conclusion of QK-xeddsa-let-age-x25519-identity-sign in kb/public/_answers.md state that one string serves as recipient and verification key only if XEdDSA's k is the clamped X25519 scalar, which the article's own open item (line 51) and the _gaps.md entry leave unstated. Found by the SP-tcis5f23 review (S3).

run: import pathlib,sys; a=pathlib.Path('kb/public/auth/http-message-signatures.md').read_text().splitlines(); b=pathlib.Path('kb/public/_answers.md').read_text().splitlines(); ls=[l for l in a if 'xeddsa_verify' in l]+[l for l in b if 'doubles as the verification key' in l]; sys.exit(not ls or any('clamp' not in l for l in ls))
